channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Week's Frame (Oct 26-Nov 1): Between war-restart signals and diplomacy
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Persian press, Oct 26-Nov 1: Israel election crisis, U.S. war-prep signals, Qatar diplomacy, fourth tanker at Hormuz, Turkey dimension. (Source: Farsçadan)

item.title: WSJ: Trump spoke with Netanyahu as U.S. prepared to resume Iran strikes
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Trump spoke with Netanyahu as the U.S. prepared to resume Iran strikes, according to the Wall Street Journal; the call followed military consultations. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Fidan: Closure of Strait of Hormuz imposing heavy burden on global economy
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, combined with the Ukraine war, is imposing a heavy burden on the global economy. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Ulyanov: Europe played key role in laying groundwork for U.S. strikes on Iran
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Russia's Vienna envoy accused Europe of laying groundwork for U.S. strikes on Iran, responding to Germany's call for ending the conflict. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: FBI formally links $6 billion Binance hack to North Korea
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The FBI formally linked approximately $6 billion in digital assets stolen from Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, to North Korea. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: UK maritime authority reports unauthorized boarding of fishing vessel in Arabian Sea
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UKMTO reported unauthorized persons boarded a large fishing vessel in Arabian Sea waters; authorities assess it may be linked to organized piracy. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Fourth tanker caught fire in Hormuz: Sepah says mine, FT says attack
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: A supertanker caught fire in Hormuz; Sepah blamed a mine, FT reported deliberate attack with sticky mine. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Qatar's mediators shuttled between Tehran and Doha; framework claim persists
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Qatari mediators spent 12 hours in Tehran; Al Arabiya claims draft includes uranium transfer and Chinese guarantor role. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.title: Canadian intelligence: We thwarted Iran's \"lethal\" plots
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: CSIS and RCMP confirmed they have thwarted lethal plots by Iranian intelligence services operating in Canada. (Source: IranIntl)

item.title: U.S. Treasury: Iran's inflation climbed to 90%, rial lost a quarter of value in one month
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to a U.S. Treasury report, Iran's annual inflation reached 90% in September; the rial has fallen 25% since August. (Source: IranIntl)

item.title: Despite Erdoğan's personal invitation, Aliyev skipped the Ankara summit of Turkic states
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Azerbaijani President Aliyev declined to attend the Turkic States summit in Ankara despite President Erdoğan's personal invitation; tensions escalate. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: U.S. Ankara Ambassador Barrack: We're close to a deal reducing tension with Iran
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. Ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack said the U.S. is close to an agreement reducing tensions with Iran, with possible progress within two weeks. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Tanker struck by unidentified projectile in Strait of Hormuz; separate vessel burned and sank
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UKMTO reported a tanker leaving the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unidentified object; a separate vessel burned and sank the same night. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: U.S. sends Patriot battery to Israel; 'airlift' with 10 military aircraft
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Wall Street Journal reports CENTCOM Commander presented Iran options to Trump; Israel received Patriot battery and 10 military transport aircraft. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Politico: Pentagon preparing to cut $400 billion from Trump's defense budget
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Politico reports Pentagon is preparing to cut $400 billion from Trump's requested defense budget; report echoed in Iran press. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: New Kalabarg household classification: top earners may be excluded
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iran's government is applying new Kalabarg criteria that divide households into three wealth groups; exclusion of top earners is debated. (Source: Donya-e Eqtesad)

item.title: U.S. warns allies of possible Iranian strike after midterms
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Washington warned allies of a potential Iranian response after Nov. 3 midterms, AP reports; Qatar proposing a seven-day confidence plan. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Explosions in Saudi Arabia: Yemen attacks escalating
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Blast sounds heard in eastern Saudi Arabia and Najran; coalition conducted 101 air and missile strikes on Yemen in 24 hours. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: CIA assessment: Iran has three response options to new U.S. strikes
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Washington Post, CIA assesses that Iran could respond with Strait actions, cyber strikes, or attacks on overseas U.S. targets. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Israel's Katz-Ayzenkot clash: Who decides on Iran?
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: As Israel's election results remain unclear, Defense Min. Katz accuses Ayzenkot of inciting military insubordination; dispute extends to Iran strike decision. (Source: Iran International)
